_id: att rung: attitudeArDoubleDiff. DIAGNOSTIC, NOT A REALISM RUNG. att005 (bias deleted from truth, declared syntheticKnownZero, integer AR therefore actually runs and fixes 5/15) PLUS the between-tower double difference. One toggle against att005.
_whyBOTHMECHANISMSTOGETHER: The ladder has now separated two DIFFERENT virtues into two different rungs, and neither rung has both. (1) ACCURACY came only from the absolute integer fix: att005 reached 1.159938 deg, the best in the family, because lambda*(dphi - N) = b_body' * R' * e has no common-mode escape hatch -- the whole attitude error becomes visible rather than the ~5 % differential part. (2) HONESTY came only from the double difference: att008 reached an error/sigma ratio of 1.61 against 5.5-6.1 for every other rung, because cancelling the inter-antenna bias stops the filter counting a constant it merely fitted as if it were information. This rung is the first to carry both.
_theatt008NUMBERSTHATMOTIVATETHIS: MEASURED: finalAttitudeError_deg 1.649196 (WORSE than att004's 1.397941 by 18 %) and finalAttitudeSigma_deg 1.024780 (4.45x LARGER than 0.230097). Read naively that is a failed rung. Read as a consistency ratio it is the only defensible covariance in the whole sequence: 1.649/1.025 = 1.61, against att004 6.08, att005 5.51, att006 5.99, att007 5.65. The accuracy loss is the expected price of the DD -- |e_t - e_p| ~ 0.17-0.30 at GEO makes the DD observable 3-6x weaker than the SD one, and single-tower groups are dropped rather than passed through undifferenced.
_whatEACHOUTCOMEMEANS: (a) Error near att005's 1.159938 AND ratio near att008's 1.61: the two mechanisms are complementary and this rung is the one to quote -- accurate AND honest. (b) Error near att008's 1.649196: the DD's information loss dominates and the integer fix cannot compensate, so accuracy and honesty are genuinely in tension at GEO and the thesis must report BOTH rungs rather than one. (c) Sigma collapsing back to ~0.21 with a ratio near 5.5: the integer fix is re-introducing the same false confidence the DD removed, which would mean the fixed integers are absorbing error exactly as the float ambiguities did -- the most important negative available here, and it would put the 5/15 fixes themselves in doubt.
_WHATTHISCANNOTTELLYOU: The bias is deleted here, exactly as in att005/att007, so no number from this rung is a system performance figure. The DD makes bias-cancellation UNNECESSARY, so a realistic sibling of this rung (att005's toggles applied to att004's honest 0.02-cycle bias, i.e. AR + DD with the bias left IN) is the configuration that would actually be quotable -- and it is only reachable once the phase-bias policy gate is addressed, since AR refuses on status rather than on magnitude. Phase wind-up remains unmodelled and does NOT cancel in a between-tower DD, because the tower-to-satellite geometry differs per tower.
_verificationNote: buildRows writes daInfo into errStruct.diffAttRows, which is consumed in-epoch and NEVER persisted, so towerDoubleDifference and ddGroups cannot be read back from the output .mat. att008's liveness was therefore inferred from the 4.45x sigma shift rather than verified. A one-shot '[DiffAtt] TOWER DD APPLIED' log line was added for exactly this reason; grep the run log for it before believing any DD result, including this one.
